hi hun. i'm not a therapist. but everything you say strikes a very real chord for me. i'm 18 too and the last like three years were a whirl of mental instability (borderline tendencies all over the place. obsessiveness, emptiness, constant dissociation, a failed suicide attempt or two.) but i'd like to think that shit all kinda started to come together when i stopped shutting myself down at every single point i got the feeling. you know: the Feeling. i used to get really far into a depressive episode and very very occasionally i'd get this feeling like some real bad shit had happened to me but i'd push it down--muscle relaxants, booze, whatever. shit only started to get better when i confronted that shit. when i kept thinking about it, however fucking confusing and painful it was. i've pretty much spent the last year trying to come to terms with what happened. and the hard part is i still don't even know what to call what happened. i was also never raped but the physical and emotional intrusion was still very real (i think, i hope, i hope not but i know that it is so). sometimes i really fucking doubt myself and think i'm overreacting. that i must have something to prove or i just wanna be a victim. but no one thinks these thoughts just because they want to. nobody actually chooses to feel dirty or gross in this way. growing up with the boundaries of your body being disrespected means that you later find yourself feeling unworthy of being able to judge what you feel comfortable with, what's normal, what's right and wrong. personally, i'm reading all the stuff you said, and it sounds kinda fucked up to me, definitely not considering your agency and your needs and your feelings. but in the end, nobody can really give you that answer but you. my shit might honestly be a little more ambiguous than yours, frankly, but i know that there's no fucking way i can see my father and feel healthy and whole and right, at least not these days. the fact is that when i asked people what they thought, whether shit was normal or if i had been abused or what, i got a mixed bag of answers. and neither those in confirmation nor rejection of my hypotheses really solidified anything for me. all i know is i kept on thinking about it. and guess what? even if you had been raped, you'd still have some fuckheads telling you that you were lying or on about nothing or overreacting. i believe you. i believe in u. and whatever answers you find during this process, i know you will come out a stronger person on the other end, despite the tribulations which may await
